scope: Read-only source audit. Findings are source-supported, not game-tested.

effects.scope: country grants access to named country tag
effects.lifecycle: recipient's diplomatic_relation military_access active=yes/no can activate or revoke; track the signed agreement and apply idempotently
effects.use: named access agreement or foreign base access
effects.limitation: grant direction matters; access is a meaningful war/logistics commitment

effects.lifecycle: active=yes/no; pair with a treaty receipt and suspend/restore with the agreement
effects.use: port access for naval visits and logistics

effects.lifecycle: real military obligation; agreement recipient must accept; termination needs separate lifecycle review
effects.use: only for a true defense commitment
effects.limitation: can involve France in a war; not an influence bonus

effects.scope: payer and recipient country ledgers; weekly aggregation is country-scoped
effects.lifecycle: signed receipt gates matched streams; suspend both together; same nominal amount on both sides
effects.use: cash transfer, development grant, recurring support
effects.limitation: separate aggregators do not automatically link the transaction; append the matched expense stream after common expense multipliers and apply the same nominal amount to the recipient income stream

effects.lifecycle: paired opinion modifiers, counters and flags; can be removed by helper
effects.limitation: does not set quantity, price, import priority or delivery

effects.scope: country's actual exported resource volumes at global market prices
effects.lifecycle: modifier-based; global and per-resource factors enter weekly sale-rate calculation
effects.use: export-earnings programme, described as market receipts
effects.limitation: not bilateral offtake, price guarantee or reserved imports

effects.scope: resource-rights holder, target state, optional resource list
effects.lifecycle: recipient accepts rights; separate cancellation and owner revocation exist
effects.use: mineral concession and access to existing resource-investment interface
effects.limitation: rights do not guarantee extraction volume, a buyer or shipment to France

effects.scope: state-level deposit, slots, rights, construction and output
effects.lifecycle: investment project type 15 applies uranium-mine cost/speed, syncs slots, constructs a level and syncs output
effects.use: funded mineral development after deposit/right/capacity checks
effects.limitation: uranium output is zero before working mines; do not grant raw history output or promise offtake

effects.scope: country receiving the finite named bonus
effects.lifecycle: finite use count and real category required
effects.use: distinct short bilateral technical or doctrine package
effects.limitation: not direct transfer of researched technology

effects.scope: named group, possibly containing multiple unrelated countries
effects.lifecycle: requires explicit group membership/removal and suspension logic
effects.use: only for deliberately multilateral research sharing
effects.limitation: not a private bilateral licence; group exposure can be wider than two signatories

effects.scope: licensed production lines in recipient country
effects.lifecycle: modifier applies while idea/dynamic modifier is active
effects.use: limited speed benefit for licences already held
effects.limitation: does not create or transfer a production license; no general scripted license-issuance effect was verified

effects.scope: specific country's equipment stockpile and producer tag
effects.lifecycle: one-time transfer requires preflight on donor stock and atomic paired removal/addition
effects.limitation: negative amount is source-used, but transaction should be engine-tested; must not exceed verified stockpile

effects.key: recipient-state building grant plus extra shared slots
effects.scope: named target state, owned/controlled by partner
effects.lifecycle: preflight owner/control/full control/capacity, add one shared slot per level before building, then guard one-time transaction
effects.use: local public works, extraction support or port facilities
effects.limitation: no generic market effect can substitute for a named-state project

sources.lines: asset helpers; verify current source when design freezes

effects.scope: country pair, acceptance event, separate country ledgers
effects.lifecycle: paired acceptance preview and consent, idempotent relation + payment receipts
effects.use: France funds port/logistics improvements in return for explicitly named access rights
effects.limitation: access should not be implied by a generic cooperation spirit

unsupported_promises: fixed bilateral commodity quantities or guaranteed delivery
import priority or fixed commodity price
scripted issuance of a production license via license_production_speed
uranium production before a working mine exists
